maya_cs: Quick heads-up — PulseScan onboarding. Trial account, goes full-traffic in 10 days. We're seeing steady p95 ~300ms but sporadic tail spikes up to ~1.8s during peak bursts. Renewal signal is low if tail isn't addressed. Thinking a proactive perf play: try compact model swap + int8 canary + routing split by region with a fast-path fallback. Need eng help to size a canary and an enablement message for the customer.

ethan_se: Can you paste recent perf slices and a sample payload? also curious about current model and batch settings.

maya_cs: Current model is redwood-llama-13b (fp16), batching = dynamic w/ 20ms accumulation. Sample payload (anonymized): "query": "summarize conversation and extract action items", avg tokens 120. We see spikes correlated with longer dialogues + concurrent bursts from a single API key.

priya_ml: Quick micro-bench I ran on staging with representative requests: switching to redwood-compact-v1 quantized to int8 reduces median latency 18% and p95 by ~30% under 90% load. Cost delta ~ -22% token CPU/GPU. Fallback to fp16 model keeps quality. Rough numbers: fp16 p95: 1.1s (staging load), int8 compact p95: 770ms. Tail still present at 1.0s in pathological long contexts.

priya_ml: Example canary config I'd try:

```
route_policy:
  - id: pulse-primary
    selectors: [region:us-west]
    model: redwood-compact-v1-int8
    weight: 60
  - id: pulse-fallback
    selectors: [region:us-east]
    model: redwood-llama-13b-fp16
    weight: 40
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_ms: 5000
canary: {traffic: 10, metrics: [p95_latency, error_rate]}
```

ethan_se: That looks reasonable. Two asks: (1) define the success threshold for canary (p95 within 1.2x baseline and errors <= 0.2%); (2) we should enable prefix KV caching for recent conversation turns (maya mentioned repetitive long dialogues).

maya_cs: Good — canary success: p95 <= 1.2x current prod p95 and no regressions in hallucination checks (we have eval set). I'll coordinate the customer-facing note: short email + scheduled enablement call.

jorge_cs_mgr: Renewal risk: medium. If we can present a clear cost/latency improvement and a short 30-min enablement that shows admin dashboard and routing controls, chances improve. Maya — propose a 2-step message: 1) "we're scheduling a brief runbook review and perf canary" 2) follow-up with results and recommended routing.

maya_cs: Yep. Drafted two-line note to customer: "We're rolling a brief canary to reduce tail latency and cost — we'll share results within 48 hours and schedule a 30-min enablement to walk changes and rollback options." Will post once eng confirms canary window. :thumbsup:

rio-deploy-bot: Canary job queued: deploy-id=canary-4721, window=2h, targets=[us-west-1], initiated-by=ethan_se. Status: queued.

ethan_se: I'll attach a small smoke test that triggers heavy-dialog paths and a tracing hook so we can correlate KV cache hits. Also will set up temporary metric alerts: p95 > 1.2x baseline or error_rate > 0.2% -> auto-rollback.

priya_ml: I'll run a quick A/B eval on our prompt-suite for quality drift and post results in this thread. Expect initial numbers in ~3h.

maya_cs: Action items: (1) ethan -> create canary config + smoke tests; (2) priya -> quality eval and perf snapshot; (3) maya -> customer note + schedule enablement; (4) jorge -> prep renewal talking points. I'll update thread when deploy is confirmed. :eyes:

ethan_se: Starting config now. Ping me if you want me to widen to eu region after initial 2h window.

priya_ml: Initial perf run done: compacts give p95 730–800ms in canary env. Quality diffs within tolerance for our eval set. Uploading CSV to /shared/pulsescan/int8-results.

maya_cs: Great — scheduling the 30-min enablement for Tuesday 9am PT and sending the canary note now.

rio-deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: deploy-id=canary-4721, status=running, start_ts=1764200100.

ethan_se: Monitoring traces — saw prefix_kv cache hit rate at ~42% during test bursts, helped smooth tail. If we increase TTL to 10s we might get higher hit rate but watch memory.

maya_cs: Thanks team. Will close loop with customer after 48h results and capture feedback for renewal playbook.

jorge_cs_mgr: Nice. Keep the renewal owner looped and capture quantitative delta for the executive summary.

maya_cs: Will do. :white_check_mark:
